program.description: Run-mode executable only. Must be a bare supported executable such as cargo, go, python, pytest, mypy, ruff, node, tsc, vitest, jest, npm, pnpm, or yarn. Omit when using analyze-only `log` mode. Shell-like/app-runtime programs and path-like values are blocked.

args.description: Run-mode argument array for a supported validation profile, for example cargo check, cargo test, go test -json ./..., python -m pytest, pytest, ruff check, node --check file.js, vitest run, jest, npm run test, or tsc --noEmit. Do not pass a shell command string. Values are converted to strings; hidden run/dev/watch/fix/write/install/debug modes are rejected before execution.

items.description: One scalar argument item. Non-scalar array items are rejected and accepted items are stringified before execution.

cwd.description: Optional run-mode working directory. Defaults to the current runtime cwd and is only used when `program` is provided.

stdin.description: Optional run-mode stdin text. Omit for analyze-only `log` mode.

log.description: Analyze-only mode input. Provide an existing validation log instead of `program` to compress prior output without rerunning a command.

phase.description: Validation phase hint for root-cause ranking: build, test, check, lint, typecheck, or auto. Defaults to auto.

tool_hint.description: Known profile or adapter hint such as cargo, pytest, mypy, ruff, python, node, go, go-test, tsc, npm, pnpm, yarn, vitest, jest, js-test, or generic. Path-like or unknown names are rejected. Use only when output is mixed or auto-detection may be ambiguous.

timeout_ms.description: Optional run timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000 and is capped at 600000.

max_diagnostics.description: Optional maximum root diagnostics to return. Defaults to 8 and is capped at 20.

max_evidence_chars.description: Optional maximum raw evidence characters per diagnostic. Defaults to 240 and is capped at 1000.

include_warnings.description: Whether warning diagnostics may be included when no errors are found. Defaults to true.
